items.work: Chichester Psalms — I. Psalm 108, verse 2, and Psalm 100
items.performers: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra; Wiener Jeunesse-Chor; Leonard Bernstein
items.label: Leonard Bernstein official YouTube channel
items.note: A filmed performance of the first movement, directed by Humphrey Burton and produced by SFB with Amberson Productions and Polytel. The movement opens with the Psalm 108 introduction and continues with Psalm 100 set as a dance in 7/4.

items.label: Leonard Bernstein official YouTube channel; Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Filmed live at the Barbican Centre during the concert performances of Bernstein’s final version of the score. The video credits Humphrey Burton as director.

items.work: Symphonic Dances from West Side Story · Symphonic Suite from On the Waterfront
items.recorded: 16 May 1960 (On the Waterfront); 6 March 1961 (Symphonic Dances); Manhattan Center, New York
items.label: Sony Classical; originally Columbia
items.note: Bernstein’s recordings of two of his orchestral arrangements, issued together on this Sony album. He recorded the Symphonic Dances three weeks after Lukas Foss conducted the first performance on 13 February 1961.

links.title: Bernstein: Symphonic Dances from “West Side Story” & Symphonic Suite from “On The Waterfront” (Remastered) on Apple Music

items.performers: Kiri Te Kanawa, José Carreras, Tatiana Troyanos, Kurt Ollmann, Marilyn Horne; orchestra and chorus conducted by Leonard Bernstein
items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: The recording made by the composer with opera singers in the principal roles, issued in 1985. The Bernstein Office’s guide to the show notes that he had not conducted a performance of it before this recording.
